title: Ongoing Growth in Steel Production Ex-China
section_path: Ongoing Growth in Steel Production Ex-China
section_path_text: Ongoing Growth in Steel Production Ex-China
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
As we discussed in Commodore Research's most recent Weekly Executive Report, global steel production totaled approximately 144.2 million tons in August. This is down month-on-month by 5 million tons (-3%) and down year-on-year by 1.1 million tons (-1%). Steel production ex-China totaled approximately 69.6 million tons.
